text:
emily: Heads up  CI linkcheck failed on /kb/quickstart/onboard due to a missing caption on `architecture-flow.png`. linter shows `image-meta: caption required`.
raj: which doc path?
emily: docs/kb/quickstart/onboard.md
raj: ok. I think that file lost frontmatter during the rename last sprint. can you paste the linter snippet?
emily: pasted: `WARN: image-meta: ./assets/architecture-flow.png has no caption (required by docs lint policy)`
ci-bot: build #2042 failed on branch `docs/quickstart-cleanup` — https://ci.internal/builds/2042 (::linkcheck)
tom: I can pick this up. quick question: do we add a one-line caption or a descriptive sentence? some diagrams need extra context for readers.
raj: prefer one-line concise caption. Put longer provenance into ASSET-LICENSES.md + link. keeps the doc reader-friendly.
tom: makes sense. I'll add `caption: "Inference path: client -> router -> caches -> workers."` and `alt: "Diagram showing request flow and cache layers"` in the image block.
emily: can you also add a redirect for `/runtime/prefix-cache` -> `/runtime/cache#prefix-kv`? I saw a 404 in the staging preview.
tom: noted. I'll add a `redirects.yml` entry in the PR.
docs-bot: FYI, docs policy requires SPDX id in asset license entries. See CONTRIBUTING.md / docs/assets.
tom: adding ASSET-LICENSES.md line: `assets/architecture-flow.png | upstream-illustration | CC0-1.0 | https://example.com/source`
raj: small nit: use `CC-BY-4.0` if it's credited. confirm provenance before finalizing.
tom: source page lists CC-BY-4.0. updated.
ci-bot: queued lint + linkcheck for PR 221 — https://ci.internal/pulls/221 :gear:
emily: PR opened: https://git.internal/r/redwood/docs/pulls/221 with changes: 
```
--- a/docs/kb/quickstart/onboard.md
+++ b/docs/kb/quickstart/onboard.md
@@
 - image: ./assets/architecture-flow.png
+  alt: "Diagram showing request flow and cache layers"
+  caption: "Inference path: client -> router -> caches -> workers."
```
+ added `ASSET-LICENSES.md` row and `redirects.yml` entry for the stale anchor.
raj: pinging @tom for CR and @emily to sanity-check the caption. quick review appreciated.
emily: looked at the PR diff, caption + alt look good. thanks for adding redirect. :raised_hands:
tom: left a tiny comment about wrapping the caption in quotes for the markdown parser. fixed in amend.
ci-bot: PR 221 lint passed; linkcheck found no 404s on staging.
docs-bot: reminder: when merging, add a changelog line to `docs/CHANGELOG.md` under "Onboarding" with a 1-line note.
tom: will merge after ci green and add changelog entry.
emily: will smoke-check staging preview post-merge around 2pm. raj, can you help if anything odd shows up?
raj: yes, I can monitor after merge. :thumbsup:
